content:
Ethan K: hey team, day 1 snag. tried Okta SSO and enrolled a passkey (Touch ID) instead of Okta Verify. Okta shows 'enrollment complete' but Google drive still says 'not provisioned'. also `op signin` fails with state_mismatch. anyone seen passkey + 1Password CLI weirdness?

Marie (IT): welcome Ethan! passkeys are supported but sometimes they change the SSO redirect flow. first, can you confirm you're signing into Google via the Okta-provided link (not the generic accounts.google.com)? second, clear any old 1Password sessions and try `op signin redwood --raw`.

Ethan K: using the Okta link. when i click the invite it briefly shows the company splash then bounces to a Google error page. screenshot: "Your account has not been provisioned for this product."

Sam P (DevEx): that bounce often happens when the Okta app isn't mapped to the right Google group yet. Marie, could the new-hire automation have skipped the app assignment for users who enrolled passkeys?

Marie (IT): checking the automation logs... interesting: provisioning job used the attribute `mfa_method` and expected "okta_verify" to mark completion. passkey enrollments recorded as "webauthn" so the post-provision step didn't trigger. i'll patch the worker to accept both and re-run for Ethan.

OnboardBot: Onboarding status: Ethan K 2 of 6 tasks complete (Okta passkey enrolled) at 2026-03-28 08:12 UTC.

Ethan K: thanks. after the patch, any additional steps i should try for 1Password? `op signin` still errors with:
```
Browser returned error: 400 Bad Request
error_description: invalid_request: state_mismatch
```
I used Chrome.

Sam P (DevEx): for the CLI, the passkey doesn't affect the local redirect, but multiple active browser sessions can. simple flow: 1) close all browser windows, 2) open a single fresh Chrome window, 3) run `op signin redwood --raw` and paste the token into your shell. If that times out try `--output=raw` variant for your CLI version.

Marie (IT): i re-ran provisioning and assigned the Google app. Ethan, try signing into Gmail again in an incognito window to force fresh SSO. i'll also clear Okta's cached sessions for your account.

Ethan K: signed in via incognito and Gmail works now. then ran `op signin redwood --raw` and `eval $(op signin redwood --raw)` and the CLI env populated. all set.

OnboardBot: Ethan K completed "Google Workspace access" and "1Password CLI" at 2026-03-28 08:21 UTC.

Marie (IT): welcome aboard, Ethan! filing a small fix to provisioning so passkey users don't get missed in the future. ping here if anything else pops up. :wave:
